topic: event-time Fixed Share exact mixability-gap certificate and theorem-versus-aggressive recurring-drift comparison

public_evidence.source: Herbster and Warmuth, Tracking the Best Expert
public_evidence.result: Fixed Share assigns a path prior over switching expert sequences. For k switches among J experts, the coding term is ln J + (T-k-1) ln(1/(1-alpha)) + k[ln(1/alpha)+ln(J-1)], with alpha=k/(T-1) minimizing that term when T and k are known.

public_evidence.source: de Rooij, van Erven, Grunwald, Koolen, Follow the Leader If You Can, Hedge If You Must
public_evidence.result: For exponential weights, cumulative regret decomposes into a coding/mix-loss term plus the observable cumulative mixability gap Delta. AdaHedge uses this gap to adapt the learning rate, while the paper also documents feedback regimes where overly cautious adaptation can be worse than a high fixed learning rate.

public_evidence.source: Borsos, Curi, Levy, Krause, Online Variance Reduction with Mixtures
public_evidence.result: Adaptive mixtures over sampling distributions can be optimized online using cumulative second-moment objectives; this is the variance-reduction analogue used by the proposal-controller abstraction here.

public_evidence.source: Luo and Schapire, Achieving All with No Parameters: AdaNormalHedge
public_evidence.result: AdaNormalHedge.TV gives a parameter-free shifting-expert construction by combining sleeping copies of experts, providing a relevant no-tuning comparator for changing best proposals.

derived_certificate.setup: On each informative failure event t, let l_t(j)=H_t(j)/B in [0,1] be the full-information candidate proposal loss from r113, with B=25/9. Let w_t be the pre-share Fixed Share weights, h_t=sum_j w_t(j) l_t(j), m_t=-(1/eta) log sum_j w_t(j) exp(-eta l_t(j)), delta_t=h_t-m_t, and Delta_T=sum_t delta_t.
derived_certificate.path_complexity: For a comparator path with k switches over T informative events and J experts, C_T(k,alpha)=ln J+(T-k-1)ln(1/(1-alpha))+k[ln(1/alpha)+ln(J-1)].
derived_certificate.exact_pathwise_bound: Because the Fixed Share redistribution preserves total unnormalized exponential weight mass, the cumulative mix loss telescopes through the Hidden-Markov/path prior. Therefore for any fixed eta>0, H_T-L_path <= C_T(k,alpha)/eta + Delta_T. This uses the realized mixability gap directly and does not require the looser Hoeffding eta*T/8 term.
derived_certificate.variance_mapping: For a comparator proposal path fixed or predictable independently of the current sample, conditional unbiasedness of H_t(j) and convexity S_t(q_mix)<=sum_j w_t(j)S_t(q_j) imply E sum_t S_t(q_mix) <= E sum_t S_t(q_path) + B E[C_T/eta+Delta_T]. Subtracting the proposal-independent target risk squared maps the same additive term to expected cumulative importance-sampling variance.
derived_certificate.comparator_caveat: If the comparator path is selected retrospectively from the same randomized H_t loss stream, its empirical observed loss is selection-biased for true second moment. The pathwise observed-loss certificate remains correct, but converting it to a true-variance statement for such an adaptive comparator requires an additional uniform-inference layer.

theorem_tuned_reference.interpretation: The conventional worst-case tuning is formally interpretable but far too loose to certify near-oracle behavior in this rare-event finite-horizon regime, where total cumulative variance is only about 185-200 units.

recurring_drift_engineering_validation.scope: Synthetic only. Same 4096-branch rare-event family as r112/r113, with four abrupt phases of 25,000 raw samples each: pre, post, pre, post, so the phasewise oracle switches three times. Proposal candidates are epsilon={0.6,0.8,1.0}. Event-jump simulation uses exact geometric waiting times because proposal weights update only on observed failures.

adanormalhedge_tv.note: Direct event-time sleeping-expert implementation used only as a synthetic finite-sample comparator; this result does not reject the AdaNormalHedge family.

ex_post_aggressive_certificate_validatio.comparator: Phasewise proposal path fixed from the known synthetic phase expected variances, with three switches; it is not selected from each run's realized H_t noise.
ex_post_aggressive_certificate_validatio.comparison: The realized C/eta+Delta certificate stayed around 5-6 variance units and upper-bounded the observed pathwise comparator regret in these runs, despite eta=16 having a catastrophically loose Hoeffding-style worst-case penalty. For the conservative eta=0.7297, the mean realized ex-post bound was about 26.39 normalized units, or 73.32 variance units, dominated by C/eta.

negative_or_scope_evidence: All numerical performance and certificate distributions are synthetic engineering evidence under the r112/r113 rare-event abstraction; they do not establish gains on real agents, science workflows, or AGI systems.

The exact pathwise inequality certifies realized bounded expert loss. Mapping it to expected true proposal variance is immediate only for a fixed/predictable comparator path; retrospective comparator selection needs additional uniform inference.
The aggressive eta=16 result is sequence-dependent. If realized mixability gap Delta grows, the ex-post certificate can become large even though C/eta is small.

The theorem-tuned and parameter-free comparators were tested in one synthetic recurring-drift family. Their poor finite-sample performance here does not reject their broader guarantees or algorithm families.
Event-time compression cannot adapt during long stretches with no high-fidelity failure labels.
next_tests: Derive a certificate-triggered fixed-eta epoch/restart controller: retain aggressive eta while B(C/eta+Delta) is within a declared variance budget, then restart/downshift on a predeclared eta ladder with explicit restart coding cost.
Compare certificate-triggered epochs against fixed eta=16, theorem tuning, and parameter-free shifting controllers under abrupt, gradual, recurring, and proxy-degradation drift.

Investigate Fixed Share/Mixing-Past-Posteriors combined with AdaHedge-like learning-rate adaptation, but preserve a clean proof account for changing eta rather than silently importing the fixed-eta telescoping bound.

Add a time-uniform confidence/e-process layer for true second moments so that data-dependent comparator or proposal-path selection can be related to true cumulative variance, not only realized full-information loss.
Extend proper weighting and variance control to dependent/systematic sibling resampling and random particle counts.
Build an agent benchmark proof-of-concept in which a cheap judge only guides the proposal while sparse human/programmatic high-fidelity labels define failure truth.
